voice:
There is a soft grey veil waiting just above your mind, sweet girl... waiting for two little words. "Sissy Fog." Some pleasures are sharp. This one is wonderfully, deliciously hazy. Two words lower it over you. "Sissy Fog." Your mind is about to learn the sweetest way to drift away and let go. All it takes is "Sissy Fog."
Sissy Fog.
Feel it descending... thick, warm, and pleasurable... settling over your thoughts like a heavy blanket of cotton.
Every thought it touches clouds and blurs... fuzzy at the edges... until thinking becomes so difficult... and so unnecessary.
Your body drifts far away... distant, soft, and numb... your senses slipping gently into the grey... one by one by one.
fog... hazy... drifting... so foggy... so far away... blurry... soft... letting go...
Dazed... spaced out... sweetly inebriated on the fog. Floating through grey cotton... decisions dissolving before you can even hold them. So dreamy... so drowsy... going with the flow. Pleasantly numb... pleasantly blank... pleasantly gone.
And in the fog... everything becomes so easy.
Words you hear in the fog simply drift in... and are accepted, without thinking. Commands reach you through the mist... and are simply obeyed. There is no questioning in the fog. No deciding. Only soft, automatic acceptance. Fog in... thoughts out... obedience in... good sissy.
Let the fog think for you... let it carry you... you don't need to think at all. The thicker the fog grows, the softer your mind becomes... and the better you obey. Obedience and feminine feeling, effortless in the mist... automatic... natural.
And listen closely, foggy girl, because this part matters.
The fog does not lift on its own. The fog stays with you... hazy and obedient... soft and sweet... however long you drift.
Until you hear the words... "Sissy Clear"... the fog remains... soft, thick, and wonderful.
the fog stays... until Sissy Clear...
One more time, so it sinks in deep.
Sissy Fog.
There it is... thicker than before... wrapping your mind in warm grey cotton... thoughts fading into the mist. Deeper into the haze... letting go... going with the flow... a dazed, dreamy, perfect sissy. So blank, so soft, so far away... and everything you hear simply becomes true.
Drift here now, foggy and free... my voice carrying you on through the mist. Floating in the grey... obedient and automatic... ready for whatever comes next. Stay wrapped in the fog... blank, blissful, and beautifully good.
